links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of LLM oncologic summaries grounded via retrieval-augmented generation
links.effect: RAG pipeline summaries achieved mean accuracy of 97.9% (95% CI: 96.8, 99.1) for the best models and GPT-5-mini completeness of 95.5% (95% CI: 94.2, 96.7); no comparison without retrieval.
links.quote: The GPT-5-mini pipeline achieved the highest mean completeness score of 95.5% (95% CI: 94.2, 96.7) and was similar to o3-mini for a mean accuracy of 97.9% (95% CI: 96.8, 99.1).

unlisted_practices: Radiologist survey to select clinical parameters for summarization
Cost-benefit and time-savings analysis versus manual chart review

screen.reason: The study evaluates a newly developed retrieval-augmented generation pipeline using LLMs to generate structured oncologic clinical summaries, comparing model performance, time savings, and cost-benefit against human resident benchmarks, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail comparison.
